messages:
rachel_marketing: Final pre-launch thread — need: short changelog (2 lines), docs permalink, benchmark vignette link, webinar CTA copy, and HubSpot routing/webhook. Target public at 14:30 PDT after canary + 30m hold.
elaine_pm: scope confirmed: batching + streaming fixes only. i'll post the two-line changelog in 2.
devin_eng: canary at 14:00 PDT, 10m canary + 30m observability. if p99 > baseline + 25% we pause. marketing: please wait until i post canary status.
sophia_docs: building docs bundle now, will publish prod permalink after deploy. staging preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/rel-2-1-preview. adding a tiny migration note and curl example.
lila_sdr: routing: enterprise -> SDR-L, trials -> nurture. need tag name and webhook to test.
kevin_ops: webhook + routing will be enabled after deploy success. also will paste sample payload on success.
rachel_marketing: changelog draft: • ~15% typical token cost reduction for embedding-heavy flows • improved streaming reliability (fewer reconnects) — keep "typical workloads" qualifier.
elaine_pm: wording ok. impact line for email: "Lower unit cost + steadier streaming makes scaling inference more predictable."
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide — includes API diff, migration note, and tiny demo gist: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/2-1-demo
devin_eng: added monitoring hooks. will post canary start here.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 14:00 PDT. Posting updates to #release-war-room.
kevin_ops: enabling webhook post-success: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-autumn-2-1 (will test once deploy-bot posts success).
deploy-bot: Canary success at 14:07 PDT. Observability hold until 14:37 PDT. Payload sample: { "event":"release","version":"2.1","status":"canary-success" }
rachel_marketing: marketing to schedule social + email for 14:40 PDT (10m after hold). will add docs + benchmark vignette links to confirmation.
lila_sdr: HubSpot tag name: "autumn-surge-2-1". i'll test webhook now.
kevin_ops: webhook tested and working. demo signup webhook also wired to #sales-inbound.
devin_eng: monitoring looks green. no regressions in p99 or errors. ready for public.
rachel_marketing: posting social + email drafts in 5 for a quick PR. thanks all — will wait here for rollback signals. :rocket:
